description: Acceptance criterion 20 is unmet: the PR description is still the placeholder ('Work in progress — automated review pending. Resolves #375'). It does not name part 1a's changelog sentence 'Row rules are not supported yet' in changelog.d/389.added.md, and it does not say that the unreleased fragment needs a correction through the codex/changelog-notes-<reason> route.

docs/internal/database-connectors/rule-sets.md:99 says '_rewrite does not catch it', but two functions have that name: the module-level _rewrite (safety/rule_sets.py:583), which never calls guard_spec, and RuleSetGuardRunner._rewrite (:859), which does. The sentence also leaves out that run_sql's except Exception turns the error into a fail-closed refusal.
ReferencedByRule stores its two variants as three independent optional fields, and only the _variant validator enforces the exclusive-or, so callers coerce with 'or ""'.
CompareRule.value is typed Any; the scalar-or-list constraint is enforced only in _operand.

LoadedRuleSets.compiled is a public, mutable dict that defaults to empty, and the rule that every row rule has a compiled rule is checked only in guard_spec (which fails closed). GuardSpec.tables is a plain dict next to the MappingProxyType-wrapped rules.
